jobs.title: Dutch Subject Matter Expert – Audio Transcription (AI Training)
jobs.description:
About The Role

What if your deep command of Dutch and your leadership instincts could directly shape how AI learns to understand spoken language? We're looking for a Subject Matter Expert (SME) to lead our Dutch audio transcription project. You'll oversee a team of language labelers and reviewers, provide linguistic guidance, and help ensure consistent, accurate, and high-quality output across the project.

This is a hands-on leadership role that rewards sound judgment, clear communication, and a sharp ear for language. You'll guide a team through the natural messiness of real-world audio while keeping quality standards high and the team aligned.

Organization: Alignerr
Type: Hourly Contract
Location: Remote
Commitment: Hours may vary based on project demands, team needs, and project volume

What You'll Do

Lead and support a team of Dutch-specific labelers and reviewers throughout the project
Serve as the primary language and project subject matter expert, providing guidance on transcription, labeling, and language-specific questions
Ensure accuracy, consistency, and quality standards are maintained across all project work
Monitor team performance and identify recurring quality issues, trends, or areas requiring additional guidance
Conduct regular audits of labeling and reviewing work and provide actionable feedback
Manage project-related communications and questions through Discord
Host Office Hours to answer questions, clarify guidelines, and provide ongoing support to the labeling and reviewing teams
Help identify ambiguities or gaps in project guidelines and escalate issues when necessary
Participate in team meetings, calibration sessions, and project discussions
Support alignment between labelers and reviewers to ensure consistent application of project guidelines
Communicate important project updates, changes, and quality expectations to the assigned language team
Collaborate with Project Operators and Project Managers to address quality, workflow, and performance concerns

Who You Are

Native proficiency in Dutch, with a strong grasp of Dutch regional variation and contemporary spoken usage across the Netherlands
Strong understanding of Dutch grammar, vocabulary, pronunciation, and natural spoken usage
Experience with audio transcription, data labeling, linguistic annotation, quality assurance, or AI/ML data projects preferred
Strong attention to detail and ability to identify subtle linguistic, transcription, or labeling errors
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Dutch
Experience providing feedback, coaching, or leading teams is preferred
Comfortable working independently and managing multiple project priorities
Familiarity with Discord or similar online collaboration platforms

Nice to Have

Familiarity with Dutch dialectal variation — from Hollands and Brabants to Limburgs
Background in linguistics, education, translation, or communications
Prior experience working with AI training pipelines or annotation platforms

Why Join Us

Lead a team on cutting-edge AI projects alongside leading research labs
Fully remote and flexible work
Shape how AI understands and processes spoken Dutch for millions of people
Build specialized leadership and quality-assurance skills in AI data pipelines
Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

jobs.title: Financial Modeling Expert — AI Reviewer (Python & US Finance)
jobs.description:
About The Role

What if your deep knowledge of financial modeling could directly shape how AI performs the work of a professional analyst? We’re looking for Finance Subject Matter Experts with strong financial market knowledge who also know their way around Python and GitHub to audit, refine, and improve AI-generated financial modeling tasks — making sure they mirror how real analysts actually work.

You’ll review AI task instructions and scoring rubrics, then roll up your sleeves and edit Markdown files and Python scripts directly via Pull Requests to fix logic errors, close clarity gaps, and ensure every task meets professional standards. If you can build a DCF in your sleep and know your way around a P&L, this role was made for you.

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role. Candidates must have strong US-based financial knowledge and fluency with American financial terminology and conventions.

Organization: Alignerr
Type: Hourly Contract
Location: Remote
Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

What You'll Do

Audit AI-generated financial modeling tasks to ensure they accurately replicate professional analyst workflows
Validate task instructions and scoring rubrics for logical soundness, completeness, and real-world relevance
Directly edit Markdown files and Python scripts via Pull Requests to resolve logic errors, ambiguity, or clarity gaps
Evaluate whether AI outputs reflect correct application of concepts like DCF analysis, P&L interpretation, financial statement modeling, and valuation techniques
Provide clear, structured feedback grounded in professional financial expertise
Collaborate asynchronously with a distributed team using GitHub-based workflows
Work independently on task-based assignments at your own pace and schedule

Who You Are

Deep subject matter expertise in finance — you've worked as an analyst, in investment banking, corporate finance, equity research, FP&A, or a closely related field
Strong command of US-based financial terminology and frameworks (DCF, P&L, balance sheet analysis, WACC, comparable company analysis, etc.)
Proficient in Python — comfortable reading, writing, and debugging scripts used for financial calculations
Experienced with GitHub — you can clone repos, create branches, and submit Pull Requests without hand-holding
Comfortable editing Markdown for technical documentation
Detail-oriented with a systematic, quality-driven approach to review work
Clear, precise written communicator who can articulate what's wrong and why
Self-motivated and reliable when working independently

Nice to Have

CFA, CPA, ACCA, or MBA with a finance concentration
Professional experience building financial models in Excel or Python for deal evaluation, forecasting, or valuation
Experience working with US-listed companies, US GAAP reporting, or cross-border transactions
Background in teaching, mentoring, or creating training materials for financial concepts
Familiarity with AI/ML evaluation workflows or data annotation projects
Experience writing or reviewing technical rubrics or assessment criteria

Why Join Us

Work on cutting-edge AI projects alongside leading research labs
Fully remote and flexible — work when and where it suits you
Freelance autonomy with the structure of meaningful, high-impact task-based work
Apply your hard-earned financial expertise to a genuinely novel problem — teaching AI to think like a real analyst
Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch
